title: Sticky Tab Row Beside a Sidebar
description: A window-like app screen of notes in a Shell: TabRow with $sticky keeps the tabs at the top while the page scrolls the note, a frame below the row keeps the edge and the round corners of the TabPanel in view, $m on Tabs keeps a space around them, a scroll padding on the page keeps a focused link out from under the row, and a title field in an InputField at the top of each note renames its tab and gives each TabPanel a tab stop, so the panel, whose focus ring the frame would cover, never takes the focus. A TabRowButton that opens a ShellSidebar with $reveal="zoom" and a TabRowFrame with the logo, in a second Tabs above the row, stay in place, while an invisible copy of them in the row folds as the sidebar opens, a Glider follows the selected tab, also while onReorder on the TabList lets people drag that tab to a new place, and a Tooltip names each icon button. Use it for a full-page app with document tabs that scrolls with the page, and use Tabs That Open and Close for tabs inside a page.
